title: Image Processing Module
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of tools for image preprocessing and post-processing, including general utilities, backend implementations (Torchvision, PIL), and specialized processors for various vision models like DETR, YOLOS, Chameleon, and keypoint matching models. It handles tasks such as resizing, cropping, normalization, padding, and annotation management.

nodes.label: Image Feature Extraction Mixin
nodes.title: ImageFeatureExtractionMixin
nodes.description: Provides a collection of utility methods for common image feature preparation tasks like format conversion, resizing, cropping, and normalization across different image types (PIL, NumPy, PyTorch).

nodes.label: Convert to RGB Utility
nodes.title: convert_to_rgb
nodes.description: A standalone utility function to convert images to RGB format, primarily handling PIL Image objects and blending RGBA transparency.

nodes.label: Torchvision Backend
nodes.title: TorchvisionBackend
nodes.description: Implements GPU-accelerated batched image processing operations using the Torchvision library, including resizing, padding, rescaling, and normalization.

nodes.label: PIL Backend (Inferred)
nodes.title: PilBackend
nodes.description: An abstract base class for image processors that utilize the Pillow (PIL) library for image manipulation, providing core functionalities like resizing, padding, and format conversion.

nodes.label: Chameleon Image Processor (TV)
nodes.title: ChameleonImageProcessor
nodes.description: Specialized image processor for the Chameleon model, leveraging Torchvision for efficient processing and including custom RGB conversion for transparency.

nodes.label: Chameleon Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: ChameleonImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Specialized image processor for the Chameleon model, using PIL for image manipulation and providing custom RGB conversion for transparency.

nodes.label: Conditional DETR Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: ConditionalDetrImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for Conditional DETR models, handling preprocessing (resize, pad, normalize) and annotation preparation for object detection and segmentation, along with post-processing of model outputs.

nodes.label: Deformable DETR Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: DeformableDetrImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for Deformable DETR models, managing image preprocessing and annotation for object detection and segmentation, and post-processing of model predictions.

nodes.label: DETR Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: DetrImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for DETR models, providing preprocessing steps and annotation handling for object detection and segmentation, as well as post-processing of model results.

nodes.label: EfficientLoFTR Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: EfficientLoFTRImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for EfficientLoFTR, designed for keypoint matching tasks. It handles image pair preprocessing (resize, rescale, grayscale) and post-processing of matching results.

nodes.label: Grounding DINO Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: GroundingDinoImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for Grounding DINO models, performing image preprocessing and annotation handling for object detection, and post-processing of detection outputs.

nodes.label: Idefics2 Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: Idefics2ImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for Idefics2, featuring image splitting into sub-images, custom resizing logic, and padding to prepare inputs for the model.

nodes.label: LightGlue Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: LightGlueImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for LightGlue, specializing in keypoint matching. It preprocesses image pairs (resize, rescale, grayscale) and post-processes the keypoint matching outputs.

nodes.label: MLlama Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: MllamaImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for MLlama, implementing unique resizing to fit tiled canvases, aspect-ratio-aware padding, and splitting images into multiple tiles for model input.

nodes.label: Nougat Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: NougatImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for Nougat, focusing on document image processing. It includes functionalities like margin cropping, long axis alignment, thumbnail generation, and custom padding.

nodes.label: SuperGlue Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: SuperGlueImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for SuperGlue, dedicated to keypoint matching. It handles image pair preprocessing (resize, rescale, grayscale) and post-processing of matching results.

nodes.label: YOLOS Image Processor (PIL)
nodes.title: YolosImageProcessorPil
nodes.description: Image processor for YOLOS models, managing image preprocessing and annotation for object detection, and post-processing of detection outputs.

nodes.description: Represents structured data for image annotations, such as bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and labels, used in object detection and segmentation tasks.
